BUILDING CONSTRUCTION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #14
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: BUILDING CONSTRUCTION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Doors, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Doors.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Doors.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Doors.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Doors.

2. When learning Computer Aided Drawing, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Computer Aided Drawing.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Computer Aided Drawing.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Computer Aided Drawing.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Computer Aided Drawing.

3. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

4. When learning Construction Plant, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Construction Plant.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Construction Plant.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Construction Plant.
   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Construction Plant.

5. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Run with the tool
   C. Work alone with eyes closed
   D. Wear safety gear and follow instructions

6. When learning Appropriate Technology in Building, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Appropriate Technology in Building.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Appropriate Technology in Building.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Appropriate Technology in Building.

7. When learning Scaffolding, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Scaffolding.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Scaffolding.
   C. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Scaffolding.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Scaffolding.

8. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Never touch live wires with wet hands
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Overload every socket

9. When learning Domestic Water Supply, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Domestic Water Supply.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Domestic Water Supply.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Domestic Water Supply.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Domestic Water Supply.

10. When learning Windows, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Windows.
   B. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Windows.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Windows.
   D. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Windows.

11. When learning Site Organisation, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Skip safety briefings for Site Organisation.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Site Organisation.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Site Organisation.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Site Organisation.

12. When learning Sanitary Appliances, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Sanitary Appliances.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Sanitary Appliances.
   C. Skip safety briefings for Sanitary Appliances.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Sanitary Appliances.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Orthographic Projection and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Computer Aided Drawing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Scaffolding and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Roof Construction and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
